name: intel-officer capability policy
_instructions: Use this file as the source of truth for skill and tool capability changes. Do not rewrite global MCP config without explicit user approval.
_workflow: Report registered skills, shared MCP findings, and updated docs.
_rules: Treat MCP as shared infrastructure unless the user explicitly asks to reconfigure it.
Keep TOOLS.md aligned with declared capabilities.
Report missing MCP servers or usage docs instead of improvising.
Do not use this workspace to apply scheduler, heartbeat, gateway, or global capability repairs.
